body.p: Beginning of the genus Wella One day a little boy woke up among the dead, darkness around. He ate the entire top half of his mother. Then he went outside, it's good outside. The weather is good, the sun is shining, it is warm outside, so the boy went for a walk outstide. The ice on the river has melted, small fish have already begun to swim along the river. From the river he catches these little fish, eats them. Then he made his own bow. With the help of the bow, stick, birds and animals, he kills. He finds eggs and eats them, he also eats gras. So how long he lived is unknown, among the corpses, in a deserted camp. How long he lived like this, the boy does not remember. It has already snowed. He looked into the tundra and saw two people riding sleds. When they arrived, his sister turned up. The sister says: âDid I really find you, let's go with us!â She put him in the sled and went home. They arrived, the boy got warm, and fell asleep from the heat. The sister said: âHere I cooked the meat, my dear, dear, eat.â He woke up and said: âMy sister, Iâll tell you this: I didnât eat such food, poor thing. I mostly ate pasture forage." When this boy grew up, he became a big shaman. When he was a shaman, he danced on fire. He could put burning firewood in my mouth. He cut himself with burning firebrands, so he worked magic. His descendants are the children of the Conqueror of Fire. Their father, who achieved the magic of fire, was a shaman. He took over the fire. In a dream, they said, he danced on fire. Therefore, I think: the surname Walla means "he who has achieved the magic of fire", "the victorious fire."[WNB:] Verb ending unclear
